first.rationale: Targeted promotional pricing most directly addresses the immediate loss of price-sensitive SMB accounts and has prior evidence of acquisition and revenue lift. Verify its downstream customer quality and durability while comparing the strength of onboarding and activation evidence. Use a guarded test because discount-driven gains may not translate into sustainable qualified revenue or retention.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment on shortened onboarding. It directly addresses the 4% completion decline and has confirmed gains in completion, time-to-value, and 30-day retention, making it the strongest option for sustainable qualified revenue. Activation messaging is also validated but showed a smaller retention benefit. Promotional pricing is rejected because its acquisition lift came with a 12% retention decline and failure through the first renewal cycle.
